chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch.236 – Chen Jin Learns the Truth About Nine Lotos and Ji Ning
chapter_meta_description: Chen Jin receives devastating news: Nine Lotos has chosen Ji Ning as her Dao-companion. Overcome with jealousy, he turns to Firemoon for guidance. A quiet scene on Winged Serpent Lake delivers the final blow.
og_title: The Thunderbolt Strikes – Chen Jin’s World Shatters
og_description: Luo Qing delivers the same news that would crack any Dao-heart. Chen Jin’s desperate flight to Firemoon and the peaceful lake scene that follows form the emotional core of this chapter.
twitter_title: When Your Rival Is Ji Ning...
twitter_description: Chen Jin learns the crushing truth: Nine Lotos has been with Ji Ning for a year. Firemoon advises, but the final scene on the lake says everything.

lore_anchors.definition: A lifelong cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and commitment; more than a romantic spouse, it carries deep spiritual and political implications.
The Grand Xia Dynasty’s elite immortal corps, composed of cultivators at least at the Wanxiang Adept level.
Periodic ordeals faced by cultivators below Celestial Immortal; minor disasters every three hundred years and major calamities every nine hundred years.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining, where the cultivator’s Violet Palace manifests stars, moon, and sun, vastly accelerating energy absorption.
The senior third-generation disciple of the Black-White College, a calm advisor and powerhouse who can defeat Primal Daoists while still at the Wanxiang stage.
The core spiritual will of a cultivator; a damaged or unstable Dao-heart can lead to failure in tribulations and stagnation in cultivation.
A type of tribulation that tests a cultivator’s emotional attachments; heartbreak and jealousy are recognized as genuine spiritual dangers in Xianxia.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Chen Jin react so strongly to Nine Lotos choosing Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Xianxia, a cultivator’s Dao-heart is tied to their emotional attachments. Chen Jin has loved Nine Lotos for years, and the sudden, unexpected news that she has chosen a rival—and spent a year with him—shatters his self-confidence and threatens his Dao-heart stability.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Nine Lotos officially Ji Ning’s Dao-companion?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not yet. The chapter emphasizes that both are still hesitant due to their separate ambitions and responsibilities. But the year-long intimacy and her tender actions strongly indicate their bond has surpassed ordinary friendship.

He is the most powerful third-generation disciple of the Black-White College (after the Slovenly Realperson), over a hundred years old, and serves as a wise senior figure to Chen Jin. His Dao-heart is exceptionally calm, and he can defeat Primal Daoists in combat.
